_comment: OpenClaw observability plugin patch. Apply with: openclaw config patch --file ./benchmark/openclaw-observability.json  then reinstall the gateway: openclaw gateway install. This enables OpenTelemetry export of agent/tool/model spans and metrics. The plugin KEY ('observability') and its config schema follow the same plugins.entries pattern used by openclaw-basic.json; confirm the exact key/fields with 'openclaw plugins list' (see benchmark/README.md). The OTLP endpoint is ALSO driven by the standard OTEL_* env vars in benchmark/otel-env.sh, so export those before starting OpenClaw as the primary/fallback path.
